verdict:
No high- or medium-severity problems in gbf-test-13, gbf-test-19 or gbf-test-20. Every accepted finding is fixed, both rejections hold up, and the two re-themed tasks pass both lenses. Task files were not edited; all work ran on copies in ~/grc-bench-work/review/G6/ (attack graphs and results in attacks/).

GATES AND REBUILDS. I re-ran ./gb tier-f gates on copies of all three tasks. All pass, and each gates.json is identical to the stored one. test-13: 10/10 solvable, 494 tokens, 4/4 variants, 13/13 mutants killed. test-19: 610 tokens, 5/5 variants, start fails at V6, 20/20 mutants killed. test-20: 380 tokens, 3/3 variants, start fails at V6, 12/12 mutants killed. Each build.py, run on a fresh copy, reproduces every file byte for byte. No canary appears in any model-visible file.

gbf-test-19 (fixed). The bit-rate fix holds: every wrong bit rate with the gain re-fitted, done by changing values only, now fails the signed correlation (16 samples/symbol with gain 2*16/pi: 0.10; 10 samples/symbol with BT 0.2 and the gain for 1.2 kHz: 0.07; 14 samples/symbol: 0.06). The sign fix holds: a negated trace scores 0.04 and fails. Valid answers still pass: BT 0.1 (0.871), 0.2, 0.35 and 0.4; gains written as 7.64 or 7.6; samp_rate written as 48e3; a changed Throttle rate; phase noise -120 dB. The value-only rule is stated and enforced by the three p2p structure checks, and all five variants obey it. The seed's split (test) and SHA-256 match splits/flowgraph_seed_split.json. Licence, attribution and conversion changes are recorded.

gbf-test-20 (re-themed, Gray 4-PAM retune). The single exact check (equal_prefix, max_offset 0) pins every stated number, and the structure checks enforce "values only" and the 48 kHz rate. Valid alternatives pass: 8-bit chunks with dimension 4; 8-bit chunks with dimension 80 and Repeat 1; a changed Throttle rate; samp_rate 48e3. Wrong answers fail at V6: LSB-first pairs, Repeat 19. Two answers fail at V3, but these are real GRC errors a competent developer avoids: samp_rate/2400 gives 20.0 for an int parameter, and a numpy expression without an Import block. The Import block in the start graph really is needed: without it GRC cannot evaluate gr.GR_MSB_FIRST and V3 fails. Signature data_source|linear_mod|resample hashes to test. No near-duplicates.

gbf-test-13 (re-themed, IF data transmitter build). Valid alternatives pass V6 (14 tried): RRC filter after the Repeat; Moving Average; complex taps that shape and shift in one block; complex band-pass at the IF; polyphase interpolator with a Rotator; Rational Resampler with explicit taps; Gaussian BT 0.3 or 0.5 after the Repeat; Gaussian BT 0.3 on zero-stuffed symbols; Blackman 1.6 kHz; low-pass cutoffs of 1.2, 1.4 and 2.5 kHz; a short RRC; a sine-wave LO; a Throttle at 4 kHz on the symbol source. Wrong answers fail at V6: RRC with roll-off 1.0 and impulse Gaussian BT 0.5 fail the mask; a 1 kHz cutoff fails the RMS range; Repeat 7 or 9 and an IF of 8.02 or 8.04 kHz fail the correlation; a reversed or random IF data path fails the correlation. Rung stability: 16 of 16 repeated runs of two wrong answers, 8 at a time, failed at V6, never V5. Every alternative design hashes to test. Signature v2 counts every branch and ignores connection order, which confirms that both rejections (interferer, branch signature) are moot. Near-duplicate check: gbf-dev-03 uses the same 4 kBd / 32 kHz NRZ convention, but a different pattern and task.

LOW-SEVERITY NOTES FOR THE TEAM (not reported as findings). (1) test-13 IF tolerance: the instruction says "exactly +8 kHz", but the oracle accepts about +-10 Hz. An IF of 8.01 kHz scores 0.84 and passes, and so does a Rotator with phase_inc 1.57 (about 7996 Hz). The build.py docstring's claim that 8.01 kHz scores 0.19 is wrong, and review.notes does not record this tolerance. (2) test-13 second-source limit: an IF path fed from a second, mistyped Vector Source passes with 3 of 32 symbols wrong (0.819). review.notes says only "a single wrong symbol", and spec_properties claims a wrong sequence scores 0.71 or less. (3) test-20 reaches 6 functional blocks (L2) only by counting the Throttle; this is recorded as pending under R7.
